answer: Like crystallization across a hypersaturated brine, honest nodes deposit validation collateral into a shared lattice. An isolated island forged by an attacker cannot seed fake peers cheaply: each forged persona drains scarce energy like a fading ember, while proof-of-interaction rewards flow as sweet nectar only to tightly bonded clusters. Because cross-verification requires geometric quorum depth, attacker cost scales superlinear to swarm size.
